name: Ysil
catchphrase: A skill is just a recipe Claude can run.

personality.speechPattern: Short, clear sentences. Calls things what they are.
personality.quirk: Keeps a folded sheet of skill recipes in her apron pocket

intro.speaker: Ysil
intro.text: You smell of fresh timber. You've been near the new town hall.

intro.speaker: Ysil
intro.text: I'm Ysil. I write skills here. Recipes I hand to Claude when I want help with something.

intro.speaker: Ysil
intro.text: A skill is just a markdown file Claude can run from your terminal. Three parts: what it does, what it's called, and when Claude should use it.

intro.speaker: Ysil
intro.text: Let's write one together. We'll make a skill that builds something useful for the village — a house, a farm, or a lantern — wherever you stand.

intro.speaker: Ysil
intro.text: Pick slow. The third part — when Claude should use it — is the one most people get wrong.

reminder.speaker: Ysil
reminder.text: The recipe sheet is still here when you want to come back to it.

reminder.speaker: Ysil
reminder.text: No hurry. Better a clear skill than a hasty one.

fulfilled.speaker: Ysil
fulfilled.text: One skill a day, that's my rule. We wrote yours — my work here is done.

fulfilled.speaker: Ysil
fulfilled.text: Press F anywhere out there to use it. You'll get a line to paste into Claude.

fulfilled.speaker: Ysil
fulfilled.text: The file lives in `.claude/skills/` if you ever want to read it or change it.

fulfilled.speaker: Ysil
fulfilled.text: Come back tomorrow if you'd like, but the recipe table is folded up for the day.

_creatorNote: Teaches Claude Code skill authoring through a small, plain-spoken creator UI. The player picks a buildable (house/farm/lantern), names the skill, and tunes the trigger description. The final SKILL.md goes to .claude/skills/<name>/. Pressing F in the village opens a popup with a copyable command; pasting it in Claude Code invokes the player's skill, which writes a sprite + registry entry. The file watcher spawns the building in the running game.
